detail.longDescription: Hi HN! I just launched gspot. It's a tool that auto detects languages and frameworks you use in a repo and then sets up linters and agent rules. It handles JS, TS, Python and Swift. You can turn any rule and tool on and off. You can also create templates from any repo that uses gspot. Templates tell gspot what rules, tools and exceptions to install in a completely different repo. It makes it easy for you to share your linting setup and agent rules. Feedback would be much appreciated.
